<!-- pr-reviewer: 6e381cc81d4a70aec8bb28c955b5c88c39725223 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The independent safety review of 6e381cc is complete. The HOLD comment ends with this review.

### What looks good
- A selected Arc on a Waterline or Offset rings Outside pass with no air room is now refused by name (`OUTSIDE_AIR_REFUSAL`). The refusal is a `GenError::Invalid` from the generator, so the op fails with the message and posts no program.
- 2D Offset goes through the same `pocket_started_on` -> `pocket_over_with_relief`, so it has the same refusal.
- A selected Plunge on an Outside ring pass gives exactly one warning (`EntryNotRecommended`; `PlungeIntoStock` is not added). On Zigzag (no advice note) it gives exactly one `PlungeIntoStock`. Point 3 is correct.
- The pins are red on main: with main's `crates/motion/src` and `crates/sim/src` they do not compile (`unresolved imports OUTSIDE_AIR_REFUSAL, entry_warnings`; `no variant PlungeIntoStock`).

### Results (trial merge with origin/main 83e5e8a37, clean; built locally, -j 6, CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion --test pass_start_engagement` | 8 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test pocket_pass_start` (debug) | 5 passed, 2 ignored (heavy and light lanes) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Probe (local, not committed): the `band()` fixture with Outside, each strategy and each entry, with and without a stock.

```
nostock Waterline Arc:   ERR entry refused: no air room for an Outside entry ...
nostock OffsetRings Arc: ERR entry refused: no air room for an Outside entry ...
nostock Adaptive Arc:    OK warnings=[EntryStandIn { at: 2, entries: 1 }]
  adaptive: Pass starts at Outside - the HSM plan has no stock outline to start from in the air - Offset rings cut this pocket in that order instead
  entry: the arc's lead room is blocked - axial dive on the floor instead at (49.500, -19.400)
nostock Waterline Plunge: advised=true, warnings=[]   (one warning in total: EntryNotRecommended)
nostock Waterline Ramp:   advised=true, warnings=[EntryStandIn { entries: 9 }]
```

### Heavy lanes
`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run` reaches `app heavy: every target` and `motion heavy: every target`. The PR body names `app heavy: pocket_pass_start` ok on this head and `app heavy: offset_pass_start` ok on 353db74 only. This review did not run heavy lanes, because the blockers below change the code again. Not run is not a pass: the next head needs the reached lanes (at least `offset_pass_start` and `pocket_pass_start`) on its final head.

### Requested before merge
Class of all three findings: **a stand-in entry on an Outside pass is chosen inside the ladder, after the one refusal gate at plan level.** The gate in `pocket.rs` / `pocket_avoid.rs` sees only "air room: yes or no". The ladder still has its own helix, ramp and dive fallbacks for Outside.

Please close the class with one rule, not three patches: **on an Outside start-side ladder (`m.cleared_links` and side Outside), no fallback may give a helix, a ramp or a dive that the user did not select. Each such site returns `Descent::Refused` (the existing `AIR_ENTRY_REFUSAL`, which `approach.rs:214` already surfaces).** A test that walks each Outside strategy and entry (as the probe above does) can pin the rule.

1. **Re-entry after a lift with an air room (point 1).** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/descent_dive.rs:268-280` (`entry_restart`): when `air_entry::restart` does not fit, an Outside pass takes `ramp_along the pass instead`, or `helix entry instead` (the arm is gated on `m.air.is_some()`, so it is the Outside/Inside ladder only). The decision file item 4 keeps this on purpose. It breaks the #3741 rule: the user selected Arc, and the tool ramps or helixes into stock. Fix: on Outside, refuse at this site.
2. **First entry with an air room where no lead fits.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/air_entry.rs:240-249` (`stand_in`): for `air.side == "Outside"` it returns `helix entry instead`, then `ramp along the first cut instead`, and only then `Refused`. Fix: on Outside, return `Descent::Refused` at once (Inside can keep its stand-in, as the decision says).
3. **The Adaptive ring fallback escapes the refusal.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs:342` and `pocket_avoid.rs:280` gate the refusal on `p.strategy != PocketStrategy::Adaptive`. An Adaptive op with Outside, Arc and no stock falls back to Offset rings, has no air room, and posts an unselected axial dive at (49.500, -19.400). That point is 0.5 mm inside the stock rectangle of the fixture, so it is a dive into stock (probe above). Fix: refuse this case too (the advice note can stay off for Adaptive; the refusal must not).

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `outside_pocket_selected_entry_keeps_one_warning` counts only `EntryNotRecommended` + `PlungeIntoStock`. For the selected Ramp the op also posts `EntryStandIn { entries: 9 }` (an axial dive on the floor and eight ramps along the pass). The stand-in warning names other entries, so this is not a double name of the Ramp. Please say this in the test comment, or count all entry warnings.
- Zigzag with Outside: the op says that pass start is not used, but `cleared_links` is on, and Arc gives 10 stand-ins (ramps along the pass), with an `EntryStandIn` warning. Is this the same as the Auto Zigzag pocket? If yes, a line in the decision file is enough.
- No app-level pin reads the refusal on the op status line. The `GenError::Invalid` path is the standard one, so this is a note only.
- `generate.rs` and `types.rs` were already over 400 lines; they grow by a few lines.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
